question: How should the jar and water-pot be consecrated if the weapon-worship was not done earlier?
premises: The jar is worshipped and anointed with the root mantra.
It is consecrated one hundred times.
If the weapon-worship was not done earlier, the water-pot is consecrated with the sword-mantra.
inference: The rite requires repeated root-mantra consecration of the jar and, conditionally, sword-mantra consecration of the water-pot.
uncertainties: asinā is taken as the weapon or sword-mantra in this ritual context.
plain_english: The jar, worshipped and anointed with the root mantra, should be consecrated one hundred times; if the weapon-worship was not done earlier, the water-pot should be consecrated with the sword-mantra.
